dependentkink_____: Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin arrived at R-F4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The transfer made Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin a runner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F4 and grazed Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Quentin Joshgentile of the Concord (@joshgentile80). Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin. Cyril "Hollow" Dependentkin read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
rayan.zulfi: Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F9 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F9 with the rations. Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi ate while listening to the revised orders.

The barrage caught Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi in the open at R-F9. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. The shell that hit R-F9 took Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi with it. No stretcher, no surgeon, no last words. Just the crater.
Felix Zulfi had heard about Pavel "Lucky" Zulfi's courage. At R-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Felix Zulfi was peppered by shell splinters at R-F9. A medic picked them out one by one while the next salvo came in.
steini10.02: Jonas Steini told the sergeant he was a medical student. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.

Jonas Steini raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F7. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte). Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Jonas Steini helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jonas Steini is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Jonas Steini and Matthias Mart argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
